answer: To fold this chair, pull the back of the seat upward while holding the top frame. The legs and seat will scissor flat together.

narration.say: Hold the top backrest with one hand to keep the frame steady.
With your other hand, pull upward on the back edge of the seat.
The front and rear legs will collapse together as the seat folds flat against the frame.

procedure.title: Fold Folding Chair
procedure.done_when: The seat is pulled up vertically and the frame collapses flat.
safety: Keep fingers clear of the leg hinges and pivot brackets to avoid pinching.
